threads.body: [Style] Keep this helper package-private. It is only consumed by `SpymemcachedAttributesGetter` in the same package, and exposing it publicly unnecessarily expands the class surface.

replies.body:
Addressed in c0fc95f1e28ee9f642c271b01122f4364cf7a33d.

Analysis: `getStableOperationName()` is only called by `SpymemcachedAttributesGetter` in the same package. Package-private visibility gives that caller access without exposing an internal helper as part of the class's public surface.

Upsides: The method now follows least-access rules and prevents unintended use from other packages.

Downsides: No material downside identified.
